Population.evidence_source: ... if he didn't go with it [stay on at university], what was he going to do? Was he going to go back to doing manual work, what he'd been doing before, or, which he'd hated, and I think it just got to the point where you know the decision between the two things was, he didn't want to do either of them, any of them (Student friend E44).

Type.evidence_source: Parents' and friends' accounts described the inner psychic experience of the students as mirroring this external context of transition.

Area.evidence_source: The findings on academic failure paint a picture of students seeking an escape from what was experienced as an increasingly intolerable state of existence where the prospect of failure loomed large. Transitional periods in the academic year appeared key in providing a context for this state of mind.
